title: Decoder output
description: What an adapter's decoder returns: one result or a list of 1 to 500 results. Producer: the adapter's decoder (user code). Consumer: validateResults in services/adapters/lib/decoder.cjs, which checks every result alone against the device profile and publishes it as Sparkplug; a result that fails does so alone with a diagnostic and never discards the others. Delivery: at least once with its input (decoder-input.v1). Deduplication key: messageId per adapter and source device, for 7 days. Results of one input are published oldest observation first, and a result older than the newest already published for its source device is historical. A connector source with no decoder (OPC UA, spec 038) emits the same shape with each metric's quality and the result's timestampSource. Read tolerantly: fields the schema does not list are ignored. Not expressible here: metric names must exist in the device profile and be unique within a result, each value must match the parameter's data_type, a unit must match the profile's, and observedAt may be at most 5 minutes in the future.

sourceDeviceId.description: The manufacturer's device identifier, not blank.

name.description: A profile parameter key; unique within the result.

value.description: Typed by the profile parameter's data_type: a finite number (an integer must be a safe integer), a boolean or a string. Null only for a value whose quality is bad.

unit.description: When given it equals the profile parameter's unit.

quality.description: How far the source vouches for the value; good when absent. A bad value is null and stored as invalid with the reason; an uncertain value is stored with its value and quality uncertain.

reason.description: Why the value is uncertain or bad, in words a person reads, for example "No communication with the device".

observedAt.description: When the device observed the values; at most 5 minutes in the future. Without it the result is receipt-timed.

messageId.description: Deduplicates per adapter and source device for 7 days.

timestampSource.description: What observedAt is: the device's own time (source, the default when observedAt is given), the time a server confirmed the value on a periodic read (server), or when the platform received it because the source's clock was out of bounds (receipt).
